moves.name: Paldea Passion
moves.description: Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 1 rank. Applies Paldea Circle (Physical) to the allied field of play. Paldea Circle (Physical) grants all of the following effects: Powers up the physical attack moves and physical sync moves of all allied sync pairs by 10%. Reduces physical attack move and physical sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 5%. The more sync pairs with the Paldea theme that are on the allied field of play, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 40%, and the maximum damage reduction is 14%.)

moves.name: Eagle Eye Zen Headbutt

Activation Condition: When a circle is applied to the allied field of play.
Deactivation Condition: When there are no longer any circles applied to the allied field of play.
